editorialSummary.heading: Richardson ISD 2026-27 calendar highlights
highlights: First day Wednesday, August 12, and last day Wednesday, May 26
Winter break and the January 5 student holiday form one continuous no-school period
Six districtwide early-release dates, with dismissal two hours early
paragraphs: Richardson ISD students following the regular calendar begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and finish Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Fall Break runs October 8–12, and students are also off November 2–3. Students have no classes November 23–27: November 23–25 are student holidays/staff exchange days, followed by the Thanksgiving holiday November 26–27.

December 18 is an early-release day and the end of the second grading period. Winter Break runs December 21–January 4; January 5 is a student holiday/staff professional-learning day, so students return January 6. Spring Break is March 15–19.

March 26 and April 23 are make-up days only if needed and remain subject to change. Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy follow the separate ADSY calendar and begin one day earlier, on August 11.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Richardson ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Most Richardson ISD students begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy use the separate ADSY calendar and begin August 11.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Richardson ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. It is an early-release day for all campuses and the end of the fourth grading period.

faqs.question: When is Richardson ISD Fall Break?
faqs.answer: Fall Break runs Thursday, October 8, through Monday, October 12, 2026. Students have three school weekdays off, plus the weekend, and return Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Does Richardson ISD have school on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, is a student and staff holiday for Labor Day.

faqs.question: When is Richardson ISD Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes November 23–27, 2026. November 23–25 are student holidays/staff exchange days, and November 26–27 are the Thanksgiving holiday.

faqs.question: Does Richardson ISD have school on November 2–3, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Students do not attend November 2–3 while staff have professional-learning days. Classes resume Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: When is Richardson ISD winter break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. January 5 is also a student holiday for staff professional learning, so students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When do Richardson ISD students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. Winter Break ends January 4, and January 5 is a student holiday and staff professional-learning day.

faqs.question: When does the second semester begin in Richardson ISD?
faqs.answer: The second semester begins Wednesday, January 6, 2027, when students return after Winter Break and the January 5 student holiday.

faqs.question: Does Richardson ISD have school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a student and staff holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: Does Richardson ISD have school on February 15, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. February 15 is a student holiday and staff professional-learning day. Students return Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: When is Richardson ISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Are March 26 and April 23 Richardson ISD holidays?
faqs.answer: March 26 and April 23, 2027, are make-up days only if needed and remain subject to change. Check district updates before relying on either date as a day off.

faqs.question: What are the Richardson ISD early-release dates?
faqs.answer: Districtwide early release is scheduled August 26, September 23, December 18, February 3, May 5 and May 26. The final early release is also the last day of school.

faqs.question: What time does Richardson ISD dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: Dismissal is two hours earlier than normal: 1:10 p.m. for elementary, 1:50 p.m. for junior high and middle school, and 2:20 p.m. for high school. Pre-K families should check with their home campus.

faqs.question: What are the Richardson ISD grading-period end dates?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 7, December 18, March 12 and May 26. The second and fourth periods end on districtwide early-release days.

faqs.question: What are Richardson ISD's regular school hours?
faqs.answer: Elementary schools run 7:50 a.m.–3:10 p.m., junior high and middle schools 8:15 a.m.–3:50 p.m., and high schools 9:00 a.m.–4:20 p.m. Pre-K times vary by campus.

faqs.question: Which Richardson ISD schools use the ADSY calendar?
faqs.answer: Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy use the ADSY calendar. Families at those campuses should use the ADSY route because students begin one day earlier.

faqs.question: What is ADSY in Richardson ISD?
faqs.answer: ADSY stands for Additional Days School Year, a Texas Education Agency initiative used at Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy for 2026–27. Those campuses start August 11, one day before the regular Richardson ISD calendar.

faqs.question: When does enrollment open for Richardson ISD 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 calendar marks Tuesday, February 23, 2027, as the opening date for 2027-2028 enrollment. Families should check the district enrollment page for requirements and updates.

faqs.question: Has Richardson ISD published its 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. The official district calendars page lists the English 2027-2028 academic calendar alongside the current school-year files.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official Richardson ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF linked on this page or visit Richardson ISD's district calendars page for the current English and ADSY versions.

editorialSummary.heading: How the Richardson ISD ADSY calendar differs
highlights: Campus-specific calendar for Audelia Creek, Dover and RISD Academy
First student day Tuesday, August 11, from 7:50–11:50 a.m.
All dates after opening day match the regular district calendar
paragraphs: Richardson ISD's ADSY calendar applies to Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy. These three campuses begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026, one day before the regular district calendar. Their campus notices list a four-hour instructional day from 7:50 to 11:50 a.m. on August 11.

After August 11, ADSY families follow the same academic calendar as other RISD campuses. Fall Break is October 8–12, students have no classes November 23–27, and they return January 6 after Winter Break and the January 5 student holiday. The last day is May 26 and is an early-release day.

March 26 and April 23 remain conditional make-up days and are used only if needed. For August 11, all three ADSY campuses list attendance at 9 a.m., breakfast for all students, and sack lunches for students who receive lunch at school. Families should use their campus communications for transportation or other campus-specific instructions.

faqs.question: Which Richardson ISD schools use the ADSY calendar?
faqs.answer: The ADSY calendar applies only to Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy. Other Richardson ISD campuses begin on the regular August 12 start date.

faqs.question: What does ADSY mean in Richardson ISD?
faqs.answer: ADSY stands for Additional Days School Year, a Texas Education Agency initiative that provides participating campuses with additional instructional time and support. Richardson ISD's 2026–27 ADSY calendar applies to Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy.

faqs.question: When is the first day for Richardson ISD ADSY students?
faqs.answer: ADSY students begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026. That is one day earlier than the regular district calendar.

faqs.question: What are the August 11 hours for Richardson ISD ADSY campuses?
faqs.answer: Audelia Creek Elementary, Dover Elementary and RISD Academy have a four-hour instructional day from 7:50 to 11:50 a.m. on August 11, 2026. Attendance is taken at 9 a.m.; breakfast is served, and students who receive lunch at school receive a sack lunch that day.

faqs.question: When is the last day for Richardson ISD ADSY campuses?
faqs.answer: The last day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. ADSY campuses dismiss early that day, just like other Richardson ISD schools.

faqs.question: How is the RISD ADSY calendar different from the regular calendar?
faqs.answer: The ADSY campuses begin August 11 instead of August 12. After that opening day, their holidays, breaks, early releases, grading periods and May 26 ending date match the district calendar.

faqs.question: When is Fall Break for Richardson ISD ADSY schools?
faqs.answer: Fall Break runs October 8–12, 2026. Students return Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Do ADSY students have the full Thanksgiving week off?
faqs.answer: Yes. ADSY students have no classes November 23–27, 2026, and return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Winter Break for Richardson ISD ADSY schools?
faqs.answer: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. January 5 is a student holiday for staff professional learning, and ADSY students return January 6.

faqs.question: When do ADSY students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: ADSY students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. Winter Break ends January 4, and January 5 is a student holiday for staff professional learning.

faqs.question: When is Spring Break for the three RISD ADSY campuses?
faqs.answer: Spring Break runs March 15–19, 2027, with students returning Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Are the ADSY make-up days confirmed attendance days?
faqs.answer: No. March 26 and April 23 are used only if needed and remain subject to change. Families should watch RISD and campus announcements.

faqs.question: What are the ADSY early-release dates?
faqs.answer: Early release is scheduled August 26, September 23, December 18, February 3, May 5 and May 26. ADSY elementary campuses dismiss two hours earlier than normal.

faqs.question: What time do ADSY elementary students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The published elementary schedule is 7:50 a.m.–1:10 p.m. on early-release days. Pre-K families and RISD Academy families should confirm program-specific times with their campus.

faqs.question: Do ADSY campuses use different grading periods?
faqs.answer: No. ADSY grading periods end October 7, December 18, March 12 and May 26, the same dates used on the regular district calendar.

faqs.question: Where can families download the Richardson ISD ADSY calendar?
faqs.answer: The official ADSY PDF is linked on this page and on Richardson ISD's district calendars page, alongside the regular English calendars.
